verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲ ਏਕ ਘਰੀ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹ ਕੈ ਸਤੀ ਹੋਇ ਧੰਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ਕਹਤ ਹੈ ਸਕਲ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: a(n)t kaal ek gharee nigreh kai satee hoi dha(n)n dha(n)n kahat hai sakal sa(n)saar jee ||

en.bdb: Controlling her mind and with utmost determination, when a woman jumps into the pyre of her husband and self immolates herself, the whole world applauds her effort of being a loving and devoted wife.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲ ਏਕ ਘਰੀ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹ ਕੈ ਜੋਧਾ ਜੂਝੈ ਇਤ ਉਤ ਜਤ ਕਤ ਹੋਤ ਜੈ ਜੈਕਾਰ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: a(n)t kaal ek gharee nigreh kai jodhaa joojhai it ut jat kat hot jai jaikaar jee ||

en.bdb: As a brave warrior lays down his life fighting for his noble cause determinedly till the end, he is applauded here, there and everywhere as a martyr.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲ ਏਕ ਘਰੀ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹ ਕੈ ਚੋਰੁ ਮਰੈ ਫਾਸੀ ਕੈ ਸੂਰੀ ਚਢਾਏ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਧਿਕਾਰ ਜੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: a(n)t kaal ek gharee nigreh kai chor marai faasee kai sooree chaddaae jag meh dhikaar jee ||

en.bdb: Contrary to this, as a thief determinedly makes up his mind to commit theft, if caught, he is jailed, hanged or punished, he is degraded and rebuked the world over

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਕੈ ਅਸਾਧ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੁਭਾਵ ਗਤਿ ਮਾਨਸ ਅਉਤਾਰ ਜੀ ॥੭੦॥
verses.translit_en: taise dhuramat gurmat kai asaadh saadh sa(n)gat subhaav gat maanas aautaar jee ||70||

en.bdb: Similarly one becomes bad and wicked with base wisdom whereas accepting and abiding by Guru's wisdom makes a person noble and virtuous. A human being makes his life a success or failure according to the company he keeps or his devotion to the holy congregation. (70)
